name: SHIP-READY Phase 3 — B-1 per-comment Report ink (CommentBubble, other-person surface)
_doc: PURPOSE: choose the ink for the new per-comment Report control with the contrast script, not
the eye (PROTECT-5). The flag Report pill reused an already-banked pair (inkGlassMuted on the
bulk detail sheet) and needed no run; this control sits on a DIFFERENT surface, so its pair is
new and must be arbitrated before it renders.
SURFACE: the other-person comment bubble is color.surfaceNeutral — an OPAQUE fill (#eef1f5
light / #323237 dark), not glass. So the stack is EMPTY and surfaceNeutral is itself the base.
There is no worst-case backdrop to composite over: the fill is not translucent.
SHIPPED rows are the control group, declared so the chosen candidate is compared against what
the bubble already puts on that fill — body text, timestamp, byline.
EXPECTED EXIT: 1. This is a DIAGNOSTIC set. The only FAILing rows are two SHIPPED pairs (the
bubble timestamp, color.textSubtle on surfaceNeutral: 4.37:1 light / 3.69:1 dark). That
failure predates this work item and is untouched by it — it is banked here as a FINDING, in
the same shape 08_G3_GRABBER_ARBITER.md banked the shipped borderStrong rows. Both CANDIDATE
rows pass; the one that shipped is textMuted.
MIN 4.5 THROUGHOUT: the control renders at font.size.xs (12) semibold, which is NOT WCAG large
text (that needs 14pt bold / 18pt regular), so the normal-text floor is the honest one.
